title: 广场边建寺
A mosque by the square
body: 沙克色孜·米尔扎在这里建起清真寺。
Saqsiz Mirza founded a mosque on this site in Kashgar.

title: 院落扩建
Enlarging the courtyard
body: 十九世纪的改扩建奠定了今天寺院的规模。
A major rebuilding gave the mosque much of its present extent.

title: 家族墓园开建
A family burial ground
body: 玛木特·玉素布安葬于此，家族墓园由此形成。
The burial of Muhammad Yusuf established the family burial ground.

title: 陵园修复完工
Rebuilding the mausoleum
body: 历时四年的工程完工，形成陵园今天的大体格局。
A four-year rebuilding campaign established much of the complex seen today.

title: 古寺兴建
Building on the plain
body: 莫尔寺早期建筑可追溯至公元二至三世纪。
The earliest buildings at Mor date to the second or third century CE.

title: 从地表走向探方
Opening the trenches
body: 中央民族大学和新疆文物考古研究所开始对寺址进行主动发掘。
Minzu University of China and the Xinjiang archaeological institute began a joint excavation here.

title: 喀什建站
A station for Kashgar
body: 喀什火车站在城东建成。
A railway station was built on the eastern side of Kashgar.

title: 喀和铁路开行客车
Passenger trains to Hotan
body: 旅客列车从南疆铁路喀什站驶上通往和田的线路。
Passenger service began on the line branching from Kashgar toward Hotan.

title: 迁入西北路
Moving to Xibei Road
body: 博物馆在这一年从西大桥一带迁到现在的馆址。
The museum moved from the Xidaqiao area to its present site.

title: 新馆迎客
Opening the new building
body: 新馆建成并向公众开放，藏品有了新的陈列空间。
The new building opened, bringing the collections into purpose-built galleries.

title: 山顶立塔
A pagoda on the summit
body: 乌鲁木齐河连年泛滥后，红山与对岸山顶各建起一座塔。
After repeated floods, pagodas were erected on Red Hill and the hill across the river.

title: 绿化后的山园开放
A planted hillside opens
body: 经过多年的蓄水、植树和修路，红山公园主园区开放。
Years of irrigation, tree planting and path building preceded the opening of the main park.

title: 大巴扎开市
The bazaar opens
body: 国际大巴扎正式营业，为二道桥商区增添了一处集中交易空间。
The International Grand Bazaar opened for trade in the Erdaoqiao district.

title: 集市延伸到街上
The market reaches the street
body: 步行街扩建启动，周边街道的建筑立面也开始修整。
Work began on the pedestrian shopping streets and on the façades around them.

title: 二宫建站
The Ergong station
body: 铁路在这里设立二宫站，成为后来新客站的前身。
Ergong station was established here, long before the new passenger terminal.

title: 新客站试运营
The new terminal takes passengers
body: 新乌鲁木齐站开始试运营，首批动车往返哈密。
Trial services began at the new station with trains running to and from Hami.

title: 重建红山上的宫殿
Rebuilding on Red Hill
body: 五世达赖喇嘛开始在红山重建宫殿，先期工程包括白宫。
The Fifth Dalai Lama began rebuilding the palace on Marpori, starting with the White Palace.

title: 宫殿列入世界遗产
Inscription on the World Heritage List
body: 布达拉宫成为拉萨历史建筑群最先列入世界遗产的部分。
The Potala was the first part of Lhasa’s historic ensemble to enter the World Heritage List.

title: 寺内举行祈愿法会
A prayer festival at the Jokhang
body: 宗喀巴召集僧众在寺内举行祈愿大法会。
Tsongkhapa gathered monks at the temple for the Great Prayer Festival.

title: 建筑群扩大
Joining the Lhasa ensemble
body: 大昭寺作为布达拉宫历史建筑群的扩展项目列入世界遗产。
The Jokhang joined the Potala Palace ensemble as an extension of the World Heritage property.

title: 格桑颇章兴建
Building Kelsang Palace
body: 七世达赖喇嘛在园内兴建格桑颇章，后来在此办理夏季政务。
The Seventh Dalai Lama built Kelsang Palace, later used for summer audiences.

title: 园林列入世界遗产
The gardens join the ensemble
body: 罗布林卡作为拉萨布达拉宫历史建筑群的一部分列入世界遗产。
Norbulingka became part of Lhasa’s Potala Palace World Heritage ensemble.

title: 山麓建寺
Founding the monastery
body: 绛央却杰主持在拉萨西郊修建哲蚌寺。
Jamyang Chöjé founded Drepung on the slopes west of Lhasa.

title: 远方的分院
A monastery in exile
body: 流亡僧众在印度南部蒙德戈德重建哲蚌寺，延续了这座寺院的传承。
Monks in exile re-established Drepung at Mundgod in southern India.

title: 为重建大寺捐资
A community raises funds to rebuild
body: 青海各地居民捐资，在东关重建清真寺。工程于次年完工，记录重建经过的碑刻后来在院内留存下来。
Residents across Qinghai contributed to rebuilding the mosque at Dongguan. Work finished the following year. An inscription in the courtyard preserved an account of the rebuilding.

title: 省级保护
Protection in Qinghai
body: 东关清真大寺列入青海省文物保护单位。
Qinghai listed Dongguan Mosque for provincial heritage protection.

title: 列入全国名录
National listing
body: 寺院列入第七批全国重点文物保护单位。
The mosque entered China’s seventh national register of protected heritage sites.

title: 先有纪念塔
A stupa comes first
body: 宗喀巴的母亲在其出生地建起纪念塔。
Tsongkhapa’s mother erected a commemorative stupa at his birthplace.

title: 塔旁建寺
A temple beside the stupa
body: 僧人在塔南修建寺院与僧舍，这里逐渐发展为塔尔寺。
A temple and monks’ quarters rose south of the stupa and developed into Kumbum Monastery.

title: 博物馆开放
Opening the museum
body: 经历两次筹备后，青海省博物馆正式向公众开放。
Following two periods of preparation, Qinghai Provincial Museum opened its doors.

title: 新展馆启用
New galleries open
body: 新馆在五月开放，为省内文物提供了新的展陈空间。
The new museum building opened in May with galleries for the provincial collections.

title: 西宁开站
The first station opens
body: 西宁站开始办理铁路运输业务。
The newly completed Xining station entered railway service.

title: 扩建站房启用
Back on the original site
body: 原址改扩建完成，车站重新迎来乘客。
The rebuilt passenger station reopened on its original site.

title: 大召动工
Work begins on Dazhao
body: 阿勒坦汗在归化城营建寺院，并请工匠铸造银佛。
Altan Khan commissioned a temple at Guihua and a silver figure of the Buddha.

title: 银佛开光
Consecrating the silver Buddha
body: 三世达赖喇嘛来到大召，主持银佛的开光法会。
The Third Dalai Lama visited Dazhao to consecrate its silver Buddha.

title: 归化城的一次法会
Chanting at Guihua
body: 康熙帝巡行归化城期间，在席力图召参加诵经法会。
On a visit to Guihua, the Kangxi emperor attended a chanting ceremony at the temple.

title: 四种文字刻在一碑
Four scripts on one stele
body: 延寿寺碑及碑亭建成，碑文分别以满、汉、蒙、藏文字刻写。
A pavilion and stele were completed with inscriptions in Manchu, Chinese, Mongolian and Tibetan.

title: 金刚座塔开建
Beginning the stone platform
body: 寺院获准兴建，金刚座舍利宝塔也在这一年动工。
Construction began on the temple and its diamond-throne pagoda.

title: 五塔落成
Five towers completed
body: 宝塔落成，新建寺院获赐名慈灯寺。
The pagoda was completed and the new temple received the name Cideng.

title: 新华东街馆开门
The galleries on Xinhua East Street
body: 内蒙古博物院在乌兰恰特大剧院旁开放这座馆舍。
The museum opened this building beside the Ulanqat Theatre.

title: 旧馆闭馆
The old building closes
body: 新华东街馆闭馆，博物院随后转往新馆试运行。
The Xinhua East Street building closed ahead of trial operations at a new site.

title: 木教堂奠基
Founding a wooden church
body: 圣索菲亚最初按随军教堂修建。
Saint Sophia began as a garrison church.

title: 九年重建落成
Nine years of rebuilding
body: 始于1923年的重建完工，形成今天熟悉的教堂外形。
The rebuilding begun in 1923 ended, giving the cathedral its familiar profile.

title: 松花江水上涨
The Songhua rises
body: 面对洪水，哈尔滨居民合力加筑江堤。
Harbin residents worked together to reinforce the embankments as the river flooded.

title: 在江边立碑
A monument on the embankment
body: 纪念塔竣工，记录前一年全城抗洪的经历。
The monument was completed to commemorate the city’s flood defence the previous year.

title: 各界集资建庙
Building by subscription
body: 地方人士集资，开始兴建哈尔滨文庙。
Local subscriptions helped launch construction of the temple.

title: 殿院里的图书馆
Libraries in the halls
body: 文庙先后用作医科和工程院校的图书馆。
Medical and engineering colleges used the temple buildings as libraries.

title: 松花江站启用
Songhua River station opens
body: 铁路在这里开设松花江站，后来发展为哈尔滨站。
The station opened under the name Songhua River, the predecessor of Harbin station.

title: 北站房迎客
The northern terminal opens
body: 改造中的哈尔滨站启用北站房，乘客多了一侧进站入口。
During reconstruction, the north terminal opened as a new entrance for passengers.

title: 迁都后建宫
Building at the new capital
body: 努尔哈赤迁都沈阳后，在城内开始兴建宫殿。
Nurhaci began building a palace in Shenyang after moving his capital there.

title: 宫殿列入世界遗产
The palace joins the World Heritage List
body: 沈阳故宫与北京故宫一同列入明清皇家宫殿项目。
The Shenyang palace joined the World Heritage property of the Ming and Qing imperial palaces.

title: 昭陵始建
Beginning Zhaoling
body: 皇太极去世后，营建昭陵的工程开始。
Work on Zhaoling began after the death of Hong Taiji.

title: 陵地辟为公园
Opening Beiling Park
body: 昭陵及周边官地被划作北陵公园。
The tomb grounds and surrounding public land became Beiling Park.

title: 旧宅改建四合院
Rebuilding the courtyard house
body: 张作霖在旧公馆的土地上营建三进院落。
Zhang Zuolin replaced the earlier residence with a house arranged around three courtyards.

title: 院东建起大青楼
A blue-brick mansion
body: 四合院东侧兴建三层青砖楼，成为帅府中的大青楼。
A three-storey mansion of blue brick rose beside the eastern courtyard.

title: 为陵寝选址
Choosing the burial site
body: 努尔哈赤的陵寝选址在盛京东北郊。
A site northeast of Shengjing was chosen for Nurhaci’s mausoleum.

title: 盛京三陵入列
Three tombs join the list
body: 福陵随盛京其他两座陵寝一同列入明清皇家陵寝世界遗产项目。
Fuling and two other Shengjing tombs joined the World Heritage property of the Ming and Qing imperial tombs.

title: 为梵本建塔
A tower for manuscripts
body: 玄奘主持修建佛塔，以收藏从印度带回的经卷与佛像。
Xuanzang had a pagoda built for manuscripts and images brought back from India.

title: 从长安通往天山
Chang’an and the Tianshan routes
body: 大雁塔作为长安至天山廊道的丝绸之路遗产点列入世界遗产。
The pagoda joined the Silk Roads World Heritage property along the Chang’an–Tianshan Corridor.

title: 西大街建起钟楼
A bell tower on West Street
body: 最早的明代钟楼建在今天西大街广济街口附近。
The Ming tower was first built near the present junction of West Street and Guangji Street.

title: 钟楼东迁
Moving the tower east
body: 为顺应城中心的变化，钟楼迁到四条大街交会的现址。
The tower was moved to the meeting point of four main streets as the city centre shifted.

city-wall.date: 明洪武年间~Hongwu reign, Ming dynasty
title: 扩筑府城
Enlarging the walled city
body: 明初在旧有城防基础上修筑新墙，形成西安府城的轮廓。
Early Ming builders expanded the older defences to enclose the prefectural city.

title: 城墙列入保护
Protecting the walls
body: 西安城墙进入首批全国重点文物保护单位名录。
The city walls entered China’s first national register of protected heritage sites.

title: 荐福寺建塔
A pagoda at Jianfu Temple
body: 唐景龙年间，寺内修建十五层砖塔，与寺院译经活动相伴。
A fifteen-storey brick pagoda was built during the Jinglong reign, when the temple housed translation work.

title: 列入丝路遗产
Inscription on the Silk Roads list
body: 小雁塔列入长安至天山廊道的丝绸之路世界遗产项目。
The pagoda was inscribed as part of the Chang’an–Tianshan Corridor of the Silk Roads.

title: 江岸初建
The first riverside tower
body: 东吴时期，黄鹤矶一带开始建楼。
A tower was built near the Yellow Crane promontory under Eastern Wu.

title: 蛇山上的新楼
A new tower on Snake Hill
body: 重建的黄鹤楼落成，楼址离原来的江边矶头约一千米。
The reconstructed tower opened about a kilometre from the old riverside site.

title: 从勘测到施工
From surveys to construction
body: 经过多年勘测和方案论证，大桥在九月开始建设。
Construction began in September after years of surveys and design work.

title: 两岸通车
Rail and road cross the river
body: 武汉长江大桥十月通车，列车和汽车都能从桥上过江。
The October opening gave both trains and road vehicles a bridge across the Yangtze here.

title: 迁往东湖
A move to East Lake
body: 省博物馆筹备处迁到武昌东湖，新的展览大楼开始筹建。
The museum’s preparatory office moved to East Lake as work began on a new exhibition building.

title: 省博物馆定名
A name for the museum
body: 筹备处与省文物管理处合并，正式使用湖北省博物馆之名。
The preparatory office and the provincial heritage office merged under the name Hubei Provincial Museum.

title: 汉阳建寺
A monastery in Hanyang
body: 来自浙江的白光、主峰二僧创建归元寺。
Two monks from Zhejiang, Baiguang and Zhufeng, founded the monastery.

title: 重修大殿
Rebuilding the main hall
body: 中院的大雄宝殿在清末重修，留下今天所见的建筑。
A late-Qing rebuilding gave the central courtyard its surviving main hall.

title: 海湾里的铁码头
An iron pier in the bay
body: 清末在青岛湾兴建靠岸码头，早期文献称它为铁码头。
A landing pier was built in Qingdao Bay and recorded in contemporary documents as the iron wharf.

title: 桥头添阁
A pavilion at the seaward end
body: 栈桥改建时在桥头增建两层的回澜阁。
Reconstruction added the two-storey Huilan Pavilion at the end of the pier.

title: 风暴过后，栈桥重新迎客
A walk out to sea again
body: 前一年的风暴损坏了桥体。经过近十一个月的加固维修，围挡撤去，人们又可以从岸边沿栈桥走向海中。
A storm the previous year had damaged the pier. After nearly eleven months of repairs, the barriers came down and people could walk out from the shore again.

title: 教堂开工
Breaking ground
body: 圣弥厄尔教堂在原有教会建筑区开工建设。
Work began on Saint Michael’s Cathedral in the existing mission district.

title: 双塔教堂祝圣
Consecration of the cathedral
body: 工程完成后，教堂举行祝圣仪式。
The completed cathedral was consecrated in October.

title: 早期站房落成
The first station building
body: 按锡乐巴设计建造的青岛站房在春季完工。
The original station building, designed by Heinrich Hildebrand, was completed in spring.

title: 列车回到青岛站
Trains return
body: 改扩建工程后车站试运行，施工期间改在他站到发的列车迁回。
The rebuilt station began trial operations and trains diverted during construction returned.

title: 山麓建官邸
A residence on the hillside
body: 建筑师拉查洛维奇设计的官邸开始兴建。
Construction began on the official residence designed by Werner Lazarowicz.

title: 改作迎宾馆
From residence to guesthouse
body: 提督楼正式改作迎宾馆，建筑获得了新的公共用途。
The former residence was formally converted into a government guesthouse.

title: 湖边的自来水厂
Waterworks by the lake
body: 昆明的第一座自来水厂设在翠湖。
Kunming established its first municipal waterworks at Green Lake.

title: 引水回湖
Returning water to the lake
body: 为恢复一度干涸的湖面，开始从盘龙江抽水补给翠湖。
Water was pumped from the Panlong River to replenish a lake that had partly dried out.

title: 讲武堂开班
The academy begins teaching
body: 经过筹办，云南陆军讲武堂在翠湖边开班培养军官。
The academy opened its training classes beside Green Lake.

title: 更名讲武学校
A new name for the school
body: 讲武堂改称云南陆军讲武学校。
The institution adopted the name Yunnan Army Training School.

title: 临别立碑
A monument before departure
body: 三校即将北返，联大师生在昆明校址立碑纪念这段共同生活。
As the three universities prepared to return north, students and staff erected the monument on their Kunming campus.

title: 同材石料北运
Stone from Yunnan goes north
body: 北京大学决定复制纪念碑，派人到云南寻找与原碑相同材质的石料。
Peking University sent staff to Yunnan for matching stone to make a copy of the Kunming monument.

title: 重建并定名
Rebuilding as Yuantong Temple
body: 元代重修的寺院完工，采用圆通寺之名。
The Yuan-period reconstruction was completed and the monastery took the name Yuantong.

title: 山门移向街道
Moving the gate toward the street
body: 清代扩建把山门南移，并增建牌坊与殿堂。
A Qing expansion moved the entrance south and added an archway and halls.

title: 宗族合资建祠
Families fund an academy
body: 广东各地陈姓宗亲合资兴建陈氏书院。
Chen families across Guangdong pooled funds to build the clan academy.

title: 祠堂成为工艺博物馆
A home for folk arts
body: 陈氏书院改作广东民间工艺博物馆，原有建筑成为展览空间。
The academy became the Guangdong Folk Arts Museum, with exhibits housed in its old halls.

title: 城墙上起高楼
A tower on the city wall
body: 广州扩城，越秀山城墙上建起五层的镇海楼。
When Guangzhou expanded its defences, a five-storey tower rose on the wall at Yuexiu Hill.

title: 市立博物院设馆
A home for the city museum
body: 修缮后的镇海楼成为广州市立博物院馆址。
The restored tower became the home of Guangzhou’s municipal museum.

title: 市民筹建纪念堂
Raising funds for a memorial
body: 孙中山逝世后，广州各界发起捐建纪念堂，选定旧总统府为堂址。
After Sun Yat-sen’s death, Guangzhou residents raised funds for a memorial on the former presidential site.

title: 纪念堂建成
Completing the hall
body: 由吕彦直设计、1929年动工的纪念堂建成。
The memorial designed by Lü Yanzhi was completed two years after construction began.

title: 院中铸铁塔
Casting the iron pagodas
body: 南汉时期，寺院先后建造两座铁塔。
Two iron pagodas were erected at the temple during the Southern Han period.

title: 获赐光孝寺匾
An imperial name plaque
body: 明代朝廷赐下光孝寺匾额，寺名沿用。
The Ming court bestowed a name plaque bearing the title Guangxiao Temple.

title: 苏轼渡琼
Su Shi arrives in Hainan
body: 地方纪念传统把这里的双泉与苏轼贬居海南途中的经历相连。
Local commemorative tradition connects the twin springs with Su Shi’s passage into exile in Hainan.

title: 海南第一楼落成
A hall for the Five Lords
body: 珠采在此修建海南第一楼纪念五公，周边建筑群后来沿用五公祠之名。
Zhucai built a hall to commemorate the Five Lords. Its name later came to denote the surrounding complex.

title: 归葬故里
Burial in his home region
body: 海瑞去世两年后，墓园在海南建成。
Hai Rui’s tomb was completed in Hainan two years after his death.

title: 墓园重新开放
The grounds reopen
body: 墓园经过重修向公众开放，西侧增建海瑞文物陈列室。
The restored grounds opened to visitors with an exhibition room on the western side.

title: 海口站建成
Completing Haikou station
body: 车站在十二月建成，随后陆续开办运输业务。
The station building was completed in December, ahead of passenger operations.

title: 东环动车开行
East-coast trains to Sanya
body: 海南东环高速铁路开通，海口站开始开行到三亚的动车。
With the east-coast high-speed line open, trains began running from this station to Sanya.

title: 海边山丘上的五座炮台
Five batteries above the shore
body: 秀英村后的小丘上建成海防炮台。民国《琼山县志》记下了五座炮台各自的名字，其中三座较大，两座较小。
A coastal fort was completed on the hill behind Xiuying village. A later Qiongshan county gazetteer records five named batteries there, three large and two small.

title: 海口登记保护
City heritage protection
body: 海口市将秀英炮台公布为市级重点文物保护单位。
Haikou listed Xiuying Fort as a municipal heritage site.

title: 炮台列入全国名录
The fort gains national listing
body: 秀英炮台列入第六批全国重点文物保护单位。
The fort entered China’s sixth national register of protected heritage sites.
